summary: Focused retest of the 2 issues found in iteration_902 (Travel Visa Explore KPI row @ 768x1024, and missing tv-v2-kpi-* data-testids in served DOM). Both PASSED. Plus quick sanity at 390 and 1920 — all green.

retest_1_kpi_2x2_at_768.verification: Row 1 (y=391): Countries + Categories, both 365px wide. Row 2 (y=471): Readiness + Plan, both 365px wide. Clean 2x2 symmetric grid. READINESS label is no longer crushed vertically — card is 365px wide, label renders on a single line, '0%' renders normally. Fix confirmed (all 4 cards now share kpiCard style with flexBasis 45% when width<960).

retest_2_kpi_testids_in_dom.verification: All 4 data-testids (tv-v2-kpi-countries, tv-v2-kpi-categories, tv-v2-kpi-readiness, tv-v2-kpi-plan) are present and queryable in the served DOM at 1280, 768, and 390. Static export was successfully rebuilt with the dual testID/data-testid attributes.

sanity_390.kpi_layout: 2x2 grid (Countries+Categories row 1 at y=410, Readiness+Plan row 2 at y=490), each 176px wide, no crushing

sanity_1920.note: hero count is 3 (was 2 in iteration_902) because the hero has 3 'Travel Visa' text nodes now (top-bar chip + hero card title + one more likely from the airplane-icon aria/label). Not a regression — no visual duplicate header, still a single hero card.

sanity_1280.kpi_layout: 1 row of 4 cards, each 292.5px wide at y=375, symmetric
sanity_1280.note: Confirms >=960px width triggers 22% flex-basis / 4-across layout as designed

critical_code_review_comments: All previous responsive KPI issues resolved. Code in TravelVisaMain.tsx lines 285-299 correctly applies shared kpiCard style to all 4 KPI cards. Dual testID + data-testid emission is consistent across the KPI row.

MINOR (not a bug): The hero 'Travel Visa' text now shows 3 times in innerText at 1920 (iteration_902 showed 2). Not visually duplicated in screenshots — likely just an extra text node/aria-label. Confirm expected count with main agent if UX has changed.

For future: consider adding a mid-breakpoint (~960-1200) for KPI cards to render 3-across or 4-across depending on width — currently 45% below 960 (nice 2x2), 22% above 960 (nice 4-across). This is clean already.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (both focused retests PASS, sanity checks at 390/1280/1920 PASS)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_902 issues are now resolved on the static Expo export served at localhost:3000. Free-user Travel Visa flow is stable: login (fill both inputs, Enter, session cookie set even if URL stays on /auth/login) -> navigate to /features/travel-visa -> Skip onboarding via JS click on element whose innerText === 'Skip' (there is ONE visible + one off-viewport in earlier steps; use JS visibility filter). All 4 KPI data-testids are present. Do not use overly-complex regex or special-char strings inside page.evaluate — the automation harness has been known to error 'closing parenthesis does not match opening parenthesis' for certain JS-in-Python patterns; keep JS callbacks simple and prefer playwright locator + bounding_box() over page.evaluate.
